name: opencode
description: Configure opencode to use a local, OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint (defaults to http://mbp-m4:1236/v1). Does not install the opencode binary; list the 'opencode.ai' feature in devcontainer.json for that (installsAfter).

host.description: Host or IP address of the OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint.

port.description: Port of the OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint.
